name: Disarming
body:
Price +2 Bonus; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A disarming weapon improves the user’s ability to disarm a foe. If applied to a ranged weapon, it allows the user to make ranged disarm combat maneuvers using any feats that modify the combat maneuver, with the exceptions of ones that involve the wielder taking the weapon from the target. If applied to a melee weapon, the user gains an enhancement bonus to disarm combat maneuver checks equal to the enhancement of the weapon, including from other special abilities, like this one.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +2 Bonus; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells telekinesis
